detailed_descriptions.en: HAVKERMAN X is a Single Player, Post Apocalyptic, open world, First person Shooter, immersive sim with an emphasis on exploration, high risk / high reward combat, player choice, and interaction with characters, the story, and the environment. You are the HAVKERMAN, an undead humanoid risen by the spirit of the wasteland to fulfill a mysterious purpose. Along your journey you will meet many characters, good and bad, and decide their futures as you decide to assist or harm them in their plights. Explore the open world and collect new weapons, and augmentations to aid you in your journey. HAVKERMAN X includes a campaign with a branching story, quests, locations and different endings.
